text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minimal losses, signaling a lack of conviction in either direction as markets consolidate near round levels. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (51) but has dropped 17 points over the past week, suggesting weakening momentum and growing caution despite the lack of sharp selloff. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 59.3% alongside modest volume ($73B) indicates money flowing into the largest asset rather than risk-on altcoins, a defensive posture typical of uncertain markets.
